description: Source code for an Android service managing audio recording, including service lifecycle, media recorder initialization, start/stop recording, and binding logic.

classes.name: RecorderService
classes.description: An Android LifecycleService that manages the lifecycle of a media recorder, including creation, binding, and destruction.

classes.name: RecorderServiceBinder
classes.description: A Binder class that controls media recording, including initialization, start, stop, and unbinding from the service.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the service and creates the binder.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns the binder for clients binding to the service.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources and stops recording when the service is destroyed.

methods.name: killRecorder
methods.description: Stops and releases the media recorder, optionally stops the service.

methods.name: initializeRecorder
methods.description: Sets up the media recorder with output file and URI.

methods.name: startRecording
methods.description: Prepares and starts the media recorder, launches a coroutine to track recording time.

methods.name: stopRecordingAndUnbind
methods.description: Unbinds the service connection and stops recording.
